center.title: Contracts & signers
center.enterpriseRequired: Complete enterprise verification before managing authorized signers.

mine.title: My contracts
mine.heading: Review and complete your electronic contracts
mine.subtitle: Each contract keeps its frozen order, amount, signer, and seven-day deadline. Returning from Tencent or seeing a browser message never replaces an authoritative server result.
mine.returnTitle: You are back—check the result explicitly
mine.returnDescription: Returning to this page does not prove completion. Select “Recheck signing result” on the matching contract; only Tencent's authoritative result is accepted.
mine.authorityTitle: The server-side provider result is authoritative
mine.authorityDescription: Recheck only reads the existing flow. Getting another signing entry creates a new 30-minute link for the same contract and flow; it never creates a second contract or extends the seven-day deadline.
mine.loadFailed: Contracts could not be loaded. Please try again later.
mine.empty: There are no contracts to show
mine.failedDescription: The customer cannot launch a new signing flow for this contract. If retry remains available, it only creates another short-lived entry for the same contract and flow.

messages.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the new window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
messages.invalidSigningLink: The server did not return a safe HTTPS signing entry, so no external page was opened.
messages.openFailed: A signing entry could not be obtained. Please try again later.
messages.recheckFailed: The signing result could not be rechecked. Please try again later.
messages.rechecked: The latest authoritative state was loaded. The contract is still processing.
messages.completed: Tencent's authoritative state confirms that the contract is complete.

signers.title: Contract signers
signers.heading: Manage people who may sign contracts for the company
signers.subtitle: Only active handlers who have completed both personal identity and phone verification can be selected when staff prepare a new contract.
signers.separationTitle: This is not the notification contact list
signers.separationDescription: Notification contacts only receive messages and never gain authority to sign. Contract signers must be added here and complete both checks separately.
signers.returnDescription: Returning from the identity page does not prove approval. Find the signer and select “Check identity result”; only the server-side provider check is authoritative.
signers.loadFailed: Contract signers could not be loaded. Please try again later.
signers.enterpriseOnlyTitle: Contract signers are only needed for enterprise customers
signers.enterpriseOnlyDescription: This is an individual customer account, so no enterprise contract signer setup is required. Individual contracts are signed by the account holder.
signers.empty: No contract signer has been added

phone.title: Phone verification
phone.channelTitle: The code is sent by the platform-wide SMS channel
phone.channelDescription: This feature has no separate SMS account or template. It fails clearly if the administrator has not configured an active channel and a template for this purpose.
phone.unsupportedChallenge: This human verification method cannot be completed on this page. Ask an administrator to check the verification provider configuration.
phone.uncertainTitle: No safe delivery result was received
phone.uncertainDescription: The system will not send again automatically. Check the SMS channel, then explicitly request a new challenge before trying again.
phone.codeDescription: Enter the six-digit code sent to {destination}. It expires at {expires}.

create.title: Add a contract signer
create.notice: Enter the signer's own legal details
create.description: Only masked values are shown after submission. The signer must still complete both face identity and phone verification before becoming selectable.
create.name: Legal name
create.consent: I have the signer's consent and confirm these details are used only to verify their contract-signing identity.

disable.title: Disable this contract signer?
disable.description: The signer cannot be used for new contracts. Existing contract snapshots keep their frozen signer and are not rewritten.

messages.created: The signer was added. Complete both verification steps next.
messages.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the new window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
messages.identityChecked: The latest identity status was loaded.
messages.disabled: The signer was disabled and will not appear for new contracts.
